sloka: ऋत्विग्भिः उपसंदिष्टो यथावत् क्रतुर् आप्यताम् ।इति उक्त्वा नृप शार्दूलः सचिवान् समुपस्थितान् ॥१-८-२२॥
transliteration: ṛtvigbhiḥ upasaṁdiṣṭo yathāvat kratur āpyatām ।iti uktvā nṛpa śārdūlaḥ sacivān samupasthitān ॥1-8-22॥

translations.english: Having thus ordered his ministers sitting nearby, sent this highly brilliant, this preeminent among kings them away and entered the inner apartment.
